simple.summary: קַדְמַי (qadmay) means first First listed occurrence: Dan 7 4.

definitions.full: H6933. qadmay [ קַדְמָי ] adjective former, first (so Nabataean, Palmyrene, ᵑ7 , Syriac); — feminine singular emphatic קַדְמָֽיְתָא the first Dan 7:4 , feminine plural emphatic קַדְמָיָתָא קַרְנַיָּא the former horms 7:8 , masculine plural emphatic קַדְמָיֵא 7:24 .
